strings.en: Tch...! It can't hold out any longer...!
Oh dear...@How uncool of me, honestly!
Taken down in a place like this...@I'm still so green...!
I leave the rest to you...
To think someone could force me back...!!
Tch!! What an early curtain call!
Th-This is as far as I go...!
Ngh! So this is my limit...!
I'm ejecting, I am...@Ngh...! I can't even go out with dignity...
Damn it!@You won't get me next time!
Kyah! I leave the rest to you!
Me, screwing up in a place like this...?!@This is no fun...
So I, too, still have much to learn...!
A-All hands!@Abandoning ship is top priority...!!
Dammit! Is this all I've got...?!
That was careless of me...@I'll pull back for now...!
Is this... as far as I go...?
Oh, no way! This is as far as I go!!
At my current skill...@this is as far as I go...!
Ngh... Me, made a shooting star...@I'm ejecting!
Ngggh! Not in a place like this!!
N-Not in a place like this...!
Sorry!@I'm gonna have to bow out...!
For the Granzon... to be shot down...
Damn it, is this as far as I go?!
I have no choice but to eject...!
Aw, man, they got me good!
It stopped...! The sky's back to normal!
The staff were looking at the sky and panicking...
Something like an aurora appeared.@It spread out all of a sudden,@and the color of the sky changed.
No, it was different from that.
Yeah, no doubt about it!@Is it comin' down over here?!
No, at that angle...@looks like it's headin' for downtown Sapporo...!
Where on earth is that robot from...?!
I've never seen it before. Kota, how about you?
Nope, never seen anything like it.
Then it might be a genuine unidentified unit.@...All right!
I'm going after it in the Soul Saber!
That robot looked like it was falling, too.@If it hits the city, it'll be a disaster.
Y-Yeah, but... shouldn't we leave it to the Feds?
We can get to Sapporo right away.@We're closer than Chitose is.
Even so, what good's an amateur@gonna do wanderin' out there?!
I can at least help with rescue work,@like clearing rubble. So let me go!
Don't talk nonsense!@That robot could be with a bunch like@the <Aerogators> or the <Shura>!
Then that's even more reason!@The Soul Saber's a robot we built to@protect Earth from guys like that, isn't it?!
Hey, Kota, could you tell him too?@That this is crazy?
You know what that thing is?
(No, this is my first time seeing it too.)
Kota...? Who are you talking to?
Oh, it's Roa.@In his current state, other people@can't see him or hear his voice.
(...I don't know why, but it concerns me.)
All right...@Shoko, we're goin' after that robot.@Roa says he's got a feeling about it.
Okay, big brother.@I'll give Grandpa and the Feds a heads-up.
Th-Then we're going too!@We won't get in your way!
H-Hey, what do you mean we?!@Don't just decide that on your own!
(Kota, the anomaly in the sky that Jinpu@and the others mentioned worries me too.@We may need the Soul Saber's help.)
No, I wasn't talkin' to you.@...Jinpu, mind if I take Akimi@and Akemi with me?
Whoa, whoa, are you serious?!@Next to you two, they're practically amateurs!
Even so, we might end up needin' their help.@That's what Roa says.
I'll look after 'em.@The Feds'll be along soon anyway. Please.
Hmm... Fine. If Roa says so, I've got no choice.@I'll send out the Soul Saber.
I'll talk to the president myself.@Akimi, Akemi, don't do anything reckless.
(...Not only is there no picture, I can't even@get online. It's completely down.)
(But it's not a blackout. What's going on...?)
It's getting closer?! What is that?!
A-A robot?! What's it doing here?!
(To think I made it this far without@being caught in the <Earth Federation Army>'s@net... Is it due to that light phenomenon...?)
(And there was backflow in the Cytron System...@As if the Granteed itself@reacted to it...)
Wh-What...?!@Is that... its head? Something like a hatch...
Katia, Melua...@Get off first and go into my house.
Hey! Is someone inside that thing?!
My son, Touya...@But I haven't told him much@about <Ashurey Kreuzer>...
Th-The same goes for us...@Our parents called us to the moon,@and the Bellzelute...
What... what was that device?@There's a similar ring above this seat too...
There's no time to explain that now...@Hurry, get out of the unit... and go to my house...
Go to the villa... My son knows where it is...@I'll join you later.
B-But your injury... You need a hospital, quick...
Girls...?!@Were those two riding in that robot...?!
H-How do you know my name?!
Lord Sentinel Commander, what brings you here?
Hmph, you're in no position to say that.@That Throne Unit is the one thing that must@never leave Gaw-La.
And of all times,@right when the Gate of Voda opened.
Oh my, you didn't know?@In Gaw-La, they're all in an uproar, saying it's@because you took the Granteed out.
Well, thanks to that, my work... I mean,@my fun has increased.
It is, but you're not going to just hand it over,@are you? So I get to have some fun.
But please don't die too quickly.@This is a once-in-a-lifetime chance@to enjoy a feast I don't deserve.
(That's right... The Throne Unit's Orgon Energy@readings are lower than last time. Right now,@I can torment him all I like... Kufufu.)
(I can't use Larseilam... In that case...)
Katia, Melua...!@Leave this place at once...!
Th-That voice... Dad?! Is that you, Dad?!
Wh-Why are you riding in a robot like that?!
I thought the day I'd tell you the truth@was still far off...
Th-The truth...? Weren't you working@at a factory on the moon...?!
There is much I must teach you...@But there is no time...
Wh-What are you saying?!@Why would I have to do that?!
Explain it properly!@What are you even doing, Dad?!@Who are those people?!
Get in, Touya...@Otherwise, not only us, but the people@of the city will die...
Like I said, you can't just spring this on me!@It doesn't make any sense!
Touya... your anger is justified...@But now... just for now, lend me your strength...
All you have to do is get in this unit... Please...
...F-Fine... I just have to get in, right?
You're explaining everything later, got it?@...You two, get out of here!
Head toward the river! Got it?!
Don't worry... It's not as bad as it looks...@More importantly, into the rear seat...
What is this seat...?@It's like a chair a king would sit on...
Hey, this robot... Did they make it@at <Ashurey Kreuzer>?
Th-This Orgon Energy reading...!@It's even higher than last time...!
Heh, haha!@This looks like it'll be even more fun!
Watch closely, Touya...@Watch your father fight, see his true self...!
I am E-Selda Shoon...@In the name of the Sentinel Commander,@to fulfill our long-cherished wish!
To entrust my son with the imperial family's sword!@Here and now, I will strike down a traitor!
I told you not to worry...!
This is insane!@If you keep this up, you might...!
...Turn your back, and you lose your life...@That is the world I have lived in...
So Roa's hunch was right.@The <Guest>, attackin' again@without learnin' their lesson...!
But the fight with the <Zovorg> was supposed@to be over after the Sealing War...!
Y'know what they say. things come in threes.
I wonder where that unit's from...
Heh, saves us the trouble. Put 'em through.
You're the one who assisted the <Steel Dragons>...@I am Seldoa Shiun... I am not your enemy.
You know who I am?@Wait, are you with the Federation Army?
There's no time to explain now...@but I want to protect the city from them...@Help me.
I can trust what you're sayin', right?
All right...@Akimi, you stay back.@This is your first real fight.
N-No, I'm fighting too!@I won't let the aliens do as they please!
W-Wait a minute!@Jumping straight into real combat is crazy!!
This is no time to say that!@There's only three of us, counting us,@so we have to do it!
That's our city over there!@Our friends are there too! If we don't do it,@while we're in this thing, who will?!
It was just a mock battle, but we held@our own against the Compatible Kaiser!@We can do this!
So the Earthling forces are on the move.@Fine, I'll play with you too!
E-Selda Shoon!@Your power may be up, but you won't last long, will you?!
I'll be taking the Granteed back!@With your corpse still inside it!
Do not underestimate... my power now!
Damn Zovorg!@No matter how many times you lot attack,@I'll kick you right outta here!
What's with this guy...? His moves are stiff.
Get the hell out of our city!!
Ugh... To fall behind twice against@someone who's already half dead...!
But I guess I'll never see the Sentinel Captain@again. That's the real shame, kuhaha!
Then get out of this thing, and get to a hospital!
...You... will resent me...@There's no time... to tell you the truth...
Say... Touya...@The day you... were born...
When I first... held you in my arms...@how heavy you were... your first cry...
I still... remember it... so well...@You were... so... small......
Save the old stories for later!@I've got a ton of questions, but they can@wait until we're at the hospital!
Open the hatch! We have to get out, quick!
H-Hey... You're joking, right...? What's wrong...
(Can't blame him...@A robot like that shows up out of nowhere,@and his own dad...)
(I still can't believe it either.@That Touya's mixed up in all this...)
Are you friends of Akemi and the others?
When we came to Touya's place, they were inside.
You're Fighter Roar and Fighter Emmy, right...?@I've seen you online.@Are you... the real ones?
I'm Katia, and this is Melua...@We came with Seldoa in that robot,@from Ashurey Kreuzer on the moon...
A construction machinery maker,@like <Mogami Heavy Industries>.
...It's true. I carried him outta that robot.@He's lyin' in the room upstairs right now.
...Are you two connected with@<Ashurey Kreuzer>? Did you know@Touya's dad from before?
Melua's and my parents both work at Ashurey...@About a week ago, they asked us to come to the@moon... That's where we first met Seldoa.
And that's how you ended up in that robot?
Not that one... They asked us to help@adjust a different unit...
A robot being developed at Ashurey Kreuzer,@called the Bellzelute...
You two test pilots too,@like Akimi and Akemi?
No... They told Tenia she only had to@sit in the Bellzelute's rear seat...
...A girl who was called to the moon@along with Melua and me.
...<Ashurey Kreuzer> was suddenly@attacked by someone... There were@explosions everywhere...
Before I knew it, only Melua and I were left@alive, and Seldoa rescued us...
Th-Then, does that mean...@your parents too...?
(What is this... What the hell is all this...)
I'm sorry, Touya... What happened to Seldoa@might be our fault...
He was injured, but he still saved us...@And after that, he pushed himself@all the way here... So...
Katia, right?@What happened to Dad isn't your fault.@More importantly...
I've never heard of Dad being a pilot@at Ashurey Kreuzer.@And he was used to fighting...
Hey, what is that robot?@What's a Sentinel Commander? Why did@Dad call himself E-Selda?
All I know is that the robot's name@is Granteed...@Other than that, nothing...
That can't be true!@You said Ashurey Kreuzer called you there@to help adjust a robot!
You were with Dad on the moon, right?!@You must've heard something! Anything!
I-I'm sorry... I really don't know...
Like I said, there's no way...
Hold on, Touya.@I know this is hard on you, but they...
That's right. They might just have@gotten caught up in this...
...Sorry.@But if you stay here, there might be trouble.@You'd better go home while you can.
...Even if we go back, there's no one left.
My dad, my mom,@and everyone we got close to there...@everyone but Katia...
(Dad... What was the truth you talked about...?)
(Leaving me with that robot... and two girls,@and then just dying...)
